subject: Placement registry: anki_deck must score 0.99
body: Reminder per the S15 placement contract: a named classification scores 0.97 and share-based built-ins 0.93, so a .apkg recognised by your anki_deck handler should return score 0.99 from propose() to win over the built-in flashcards placement. propose() must stay pure (no writes); apply()/undo() run inside the pipeline's transaction.
